text: DSH Review Threads 为 DSH 网页端的工作区差异和 Git 提交差异提供持久化评审。它接管右侧 Review 标签页，将评审绑定到具体差异，并支持按文件浏览变更、在代码行上创建讨论线程、编辑和解决评论、提交带有批准或修改意见的评审摘要。AI 可通过工具读取已发布线程并添加评论。适合需要在 DSH 会话中与 agent 围绕代码变更协作审阅的开发者；评审提交范围可通过命令指定，无需额外 API 密钥。

DSH Review Threads adds persistent reviews for working tree and Git diffs in DSH web. Its sidebar shows changed files and line comments; users can resolve threads and submit a verdict with a summary. Agents can read published threads and add comments. Commands open working changes or commit ranges.

我需要把未提交的工作区评审关联到匹配的提交差异。

How can an agent read review threads and add a comment to a code diff?
DSH Review Threads 的功能「工作区与提交差异评审」：输入 /review 打开当前工作区差异，或指定 base..head 提交范围；面板按文件展示变更，支持在差异行上查看和撰写评论。
DSH Review Threads 的功能「持久化行级讨论与评审提交」：在 Review 面板为差异行添加评论、编辑草稿、解决或重开线程，并提交包含批准、评论、请求修改或拒绝意见的评审。
DSH Review Threads 的功能「AI 评审线程工具」：agent 可调用工具列出当前评审中已发布的线程、读取单个线程，并在差异行新建 AI 评论或回复开放线程。

Persistent, GitHub-style review threads for DeepSeek Harness diffs.

dsh-review-threads README · dsh-review-threads：`dsh-review-threads` takes over the official `changes-review` tab and keeps the
official turn diff data source. A Review is bound to a diff and owns many
line-level Threads. User draft changes become visible to AI only when the user
submits a Review. AI can add comments immediately, but cannot delete or resolve
threads.

dsh-review-threads README · Status：Version `0.1.1` is the current release. DeepSeek Harness itself remains in preview,
so review the compatibility range before installing.

dsh-review-threads README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.1` through `0.2.1`
- Node.js 22.18 or newer
- Git for committed revision reviews

dsh-review-threads README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-review-threads
```

Restart the profile after installation. Removing the plugin restores the
official Review tab; review data stays under the profile's DSH storage.

dsh-review-threads README · Review commands：- `/review` opens the current working-tree changes, including untracked files.
- `/review <base>..<head>` opens a committed revision range. Use
  `/review <base>...<head>` for merge-base comparison.
- Append `-- <paths...>` to limit either comparison to repository paths.
- Use `/review bind <base>..<head>` to open a range whose patch matches the
  current session's working Review; confirm the bind in the panel.
- `/review-diagnostics` reports storage counts without comment bodies.
- `/review-clear-drafts` discards unsubmitted drafts in the current session.

dsh-review-threads README · Review commands：The command only opens the Review panel. It does not send a conversation
message or start an AI turn.

dsh-review-threads README · Releases：Creating a non-prerelease GitHub Release for a tag matching the package version
runs `.github/workflows/publish.yml`. The workflow verifies the repository,
builds the package, and publishes through the npm Trusted Publisher connection;
no npm token is stored in GitHub.

dsh-review-threads README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm verify
```
